task.title: Design daemon job and run state model
task.summary: Define durable daemon job/run state for execution attempts, heartbeats, retries, block reasons, build/validation refs, and handoff metadata without replacing roadmap truth.

goal.outcome: Daemon jobs/runs have an approved schema, storage boundary, and lifecycle contract.
acceptance: Job/run states and transitions are specified.
Storage path and relationship to session queue/artifact status are specified.
Roadmap/build/validation/Git remain canonical truth; daemon jobs are execution attempts only.
Tests or fixtures cover schema normalization and lifecycle transitions.
non_goals: Do not spawn sessions in this task.
Do not replace roadmap tasks with daemon jobs.
Do not rename roadmap helper modules.

delta.desired: Daemon execution attempts are durable and distinct from roadmap truth.
delta.current: Session queue/artifact status coordinates claims but lacks durable job/run attempts.
delta.closure: Close when schema/storage/lifecycle are implemented or specified with tests.
